document_title: e-Jagriti Consumer Commission Online Complaint Filing User Manual

pages.text:
Help Documentation 
 
For 
 
Consumer Complaint (CC) 
Filing 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 National Informatics Centre ,  
Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology,  
Government of India 
(A-Block, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, 
New Delhi – 110003) 
 
March  2025

Consumer Complaint (CC) 
 
Step 1: Navigate to the dashboard and select "File New Case" from the left menu. 
 
 
Step 2: Choose "Consumer Complaint" from the list of case types in the selection menu. 
 
 
 
                        e-Jagriti Help Document 
2/12

Consumer Complaint (CC) 
 
Step 3: Upon selecting "Consumer Complaint” from the given case types, 
3.1 : A list of required documents will be displayed. 
3.2 : Review the applicable fee structure. 
 
 
                        e-Jagriti Help Document 
3/12

Consumer Complaint (CC) 
 
Step 4 
4.1: In “Case Details” enter the amount paid for the service, claim amount, date of cause of action, 
state, district, case category, and subcategory. 
4.2: Click "Next" to proceed. 
 
 
 
                        e-Jagriti Help Document 
4/12

Consumer Complaint (CC) 
 
Step 5   
5.1: Enter the Complainant details. Select if applicable: Senior Citizen, Widow, Differently Abled, or    
Serious Ailments, and choose the address type (Present, Permanent, or Business).  
5.2: Add the advocate from the list  
5.3: Enter the Opposite Party details.  
5.4: Click "Next" to proceed. 
 
 
 
 
                        e-Jagriti Help Document 
5/12

Consumer Complaint (CC) 
 
Step 6:  
6.1: Add an additional complainant , if any 
6.2: Add Proforma complainant , if any 
6.3 : Click "Next" to proceed. 
 
 
 
 
                        e-Jagriti Help Document 
6/12

Consumer Complaint (CC) 
6.4 : To add an additional complainant , enter the details i.e name , address etc.  
6.5 : Add the advocate from the list  
6.6 : To add  proforma complainant , enter the details i.e name , address etc. 
6.7 : Add the advocate pertaining to the proforma complainant. 
6.8 : Click "Next" to proceed. 
 
 
 
 
 
                        e-Jagriti Help Document 
7/12

Consumer Complaint (CC) 
 
Step 7  
7.1: Add an additional opposite party detail , if any 
7.2: Add Proforma opposite party , if any 
7.3: Click "Next" to proceed. 
 
 
 
                        e-Jagriti Help Document 
8/12

Consumer Complaint (CC) 
 
7.4 : To add the Additional Opposite Party , enter the details  i.e name , address etc. 
7.5 : To add  Proforma Opposite Party, enter the details i.e name , address etc.  
7.6 : Click "Next" to proceed. 
 
 
 
                        e-Jagriti Help Document 
9/12

Consumer Complaint (CC) 
 
Step 8:  
8.1: Upload the required documents i.e Index, Proforma, Synopsis, Memo of Parties, Notarized Affidavit 
and Vakalatnama. 
8.2: Upload Annexures (with appropriate title) or IA Application  
8.3: Click "Next" to proceed. 
 
 
                        e-Jagriti Help Document 
10/12

Consumer Complaint (CC) 
 
 
 
Step 9:  
9.1: Select the commission name and tick the declaration checkbox.  
9.2: Click the "Preview" button. 
 
 
                        e-Jagriti Help Document 
11/12

Consumer Complaint (CC) 
 
Step 10: Review the details on the Preview page.  
10.1 : Click the "Edit" button to correct the respective section’s information.  
10.2 : Click "Submit" to complete the process. 
 
 
Step 11: Clicking the "Final Submit" button will trigger a pop-up asking, "Are you sure you want to 
submit? You will not be able to edit the form after submission". 
 
 
 
 
                        e-Jagriti Help Document 
12/12

Consumer Complaint (CC) 
Step 12: Selecting "Yes" will generate a reference number and submit the case to the respective 
commission. 
 
 
 
 
Step 13 : Upon clicking on “Print button” will generate a reference number, date of filing, 
commission name etc. 
 
                        e-Jagriti Help Document 
13/12
